This is a rough estimate. The second photo shows only the remaining bread pieces on the plate, so I counted the fried egg, avocado, lemon, and roughly half the bread as eaten. The drinks are not visible in the second photo, so I assumed the juice and most of the latte were consumed, which adds about 190 kcal. The mass counts only the solid food.
